text:
The calves are beautiful, following the curves and not excessively long; it is as if the Creator, while fashioning the rest of the limbs, exerted a special effort to produce grace in them.

Her hands, like those of the king of elephants, are like exquisite plantains in their texture and coolness; having attained such form in the world, they have become beyond comparison to the upper arms.

Given this, one can only imagine the beauty of the waist of the flawless one, who is embraced from behind by Girisha, the most precious jewel among women.
